title: 58. Can I upload a translation in a non-European language?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: Can I upload a translation in a non-European language.
short_answer: The application also supports non-European languages. Select 'Other' in the uploading process and introduce a valid two-letter ISO 639-1 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes) language code. It is not possible to select a non-European language as the main language of your survey.
